mission.title: Medical Records
mission.description: Get the information on Morpheus held by the redpill doctor Crucic.

npc.say: I'll meet you when Cheeta is out of the way.
On my way here, I was ambushed by a group of masked men. They must be stopped!
Tell Zion that I appreciate the help. It's good to be a part of Zion, isn't it?
You'll find Dr. Crucic in the other room.

phase.briefing: In your last mission, we discovered the name of the redpill doctor who treated Morpheus after his encounter with Agent Smith. This man is known as Crucic. At this moment, Crucic is expecting a Zion redpill to help him with a group of "masked men" that have been plaguing him. We've put an indefinite hold on Crucic's help from Zion to give you a chance to search all computers on-site. With luck, we won't need to extract any information from the good Doctor himself.

enter.say:
Doctor Crucic was pulled from the pods a few years before the truce. He's been helping redpills inside and outside the Matrix since then.
Crucic has a few bases of operations in the Matrix. This is one of them.

done.say: Morpheus was released from duty? I had no idea.

Well, then... The computers gave us nothing useful.
This is your next step: Speak with Crucic. Tell him that you are the help from Zion and act as his aid.
A vacation construct? I hear that they're amazing. You can do anything in them, anything at all. You can be a medieval king. A cloud of air. Anything!

talk.say:
You must be the help from Zion. It is good to see you here in one piece. My friend was not so lucky. Do you still have time to do me a personal favor?
Cheeta has been hampering my work inside the Matrix for quite some time now -- far too long for any respected practitioner of medicine. If you can find Cheeta and put a stop to the attacks, I'll return the favor in any way I can.

done.say: I suppose you will just have to kill these masked men for the dear Doctor, since he can't handle his own problems. Once you're done, we'll get the information from him that could not be found on his computers.
Make your exit and Flood will follow up with the details. In the meantime, I'll see what intel I can get on these "masked men."

phase.briefing:
As much as I don't like helping Crucic, this will give us the inside track we need. Kill Cheeta for Crucic.
You can find Cheeta...here. Head to the new waypoint and carry out your task, {player}. I won't tolerate failure. I do hope you understand that.

enter.say: I'm reading several signals here. No IDs, but they're redpills from the look of their carriers.

done.say: Check Cheeta's body for something of value. If he has a weapon on him, you can bring it back to Crucic as proof of his death.
This pistol should be good enough to convince Crucic that Cheeta is dead.

objective.text: Kill all of the masked men

phase.briefing:
Crucic has moved to a new location. Tracking him was not easy, but I've managed it -- just for you. Don't you feel special?
Give Crucic the weapon as proof of Cheeta's death, and ask him about Morpheus.

enter.say: Bring Crucic Cheeta's pistol, then ask him about Morpheus.

talk.say: You made it. Is Cheeta dead? Do you have proof? Cheeta's weapon perhaps?

done.say: Maybe we can get the information Flood needs without violence. There are two computers here that were in a reboot process. Find them and search them. At least one of them must have something useful.

phase.briefing: This is exactly the kind of information we need. Crucic has set up a meeting with another redpill... Kill Crucic and take his business card. Do not ask questions. Do it.

enter.say: Tell Zion that I appreciate the help. It's good to be a part of Zion, isn't it?

done.say: Upload the business card to me through a hardline and I'll get a copy to Flood.

objective.text: Upload Crucic's Business Card at a hardline

done.say: Transfer complete! I'm sending the business card to Flood.

mission.finish: I have already planned out your next assignment. We'll be in touch, {player}.
